FORM 2-I

(See PARAGRAPH 71, NOTE 4)

Assignment of Policy by endorsement

For the consideration as expressed in the Bond, dated the.............. day of......................executed by me in favour of the Governor of Uttar Pradesh and in pursuance of the Account Rules of the Government of Uttar Pradesh, I, ...................etc., hereby assign absolutely to the said Governor the written policy of Insurance dated the.......................

Signed by

Designation and address

on..........day of...........19 .
